sources/swell.png: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a production pixel-art texture source for a calm Japanese coastal bay in a detailed 16-bit ship game. A single seamless repeating water surface texture, wide landscape, no shore, no horizon, no boat, no text. Teal blue water with graceful broad flattened rolling swell shapes, dark indigo troughs, a few delicate ivory/cyan glint crests. Sparse tasteful curling Japanese wave accents. Calm long low swells, not choppy, not a grid of short dashes, no foam clutter. Lighting consistent across the whole texture; no gradient to edges. Crisp deliberate pixels, restrained 12-colour palette. This texture will be downsampled to 384 by 128 pixels, so use broad readable forms. Seamless on both axes. Opaque background. Match the coastal bay palette: deep #12566E, middle #247F92, soft #49A4AF highlights, rare #B2D7D2 sparkles.
sources/stars.png: Use case: stylized-concept. Production 16-bit pixel art star-field texture, on an opaque uniform very dark midnight blue #122447 background. Seamlessly repeating field with sparse naturally scattered stars across the ENTIRE rectangular image equally, no clusters or empty sectors. Many tiny dim blue-gray pinpricks, some medium soft ivory stars, just a handful small four-point twinkles. No moon, no nebula, no clouds, no glow haze, no gradient, no text, no planets, no grid. Sharp true pixel shapes, limited palette. Wide landscape, stars evenly reach all four edges. Will register at 600 x 360 game pixels; keep the bright star cores small, faint pinpricks dominant.
